name: perl-bio-searchio-hmmer
description: The `Bio::SearchIO::hmmer` module is a Perl-based interface designed to parse the complex text output generated by the HMMER software suite.
overview: The `Bio::SearchIO::hmmer` module is a Perl-based interface designed to parse the complex text output generated by the HMMER software suite. It provides a standardized way to extract hits, scores, E-values, and alignments from HMMER2 and HMMER3 reports, allowing for automated bioinformatics pipeline integration.
